inputDenominator.equation: 21 portal-labeled rows = 7 selected rows + 14 not-selected rows

selectionCriteria: The source is already represented by at least one P5 portal-labeled row.
Accepted P1-P5 evidence identifies a one-to-many, directory, matching, common-application, paginated-catalog, or external-marketplace expansion opportunity.
A public information landing page can be read without entering a form, application, login, or paid workflow.
The source has plausible Whitefish-audience relevance that can be tested at child level; selection is not acceptance.
The batch spans distinct high-yield architectures while remaining bounded to five parent sources.

queue.selectionRationale: Montana-wide audience and an accepted historical observation that one public page names multiple scholarships behind a shared eligibility/application workflow.
queue.plannedBoundary: Read only the public information page and public child information pages. Do not open the GrantInterface login or application workflow.

queue.selectionRationale: Highest local postsecondary relevance and an accepted historical observation of a large public catalog whose page and award denominator must be measured rather than assumed current.
queue.plannedBoundary: Read only public catalog and opportunity pages. Do not open sign-in, account, or application routes.

queue.selectionRationale: The official public page historically names three distinct awards with shared application routes, while two testing-sheet portal rows may collide with those children.
queue.plannedBoundary: Read only the official public information page and linked public scholarship documents. Do not enter or submit an application.

queue.selectionRationale: Two existing portal rows point to a national multi-program source that includes degree-path and state-specific opportunities; child-level collision and cycle checks are required.
queue.plannedBoundary: Read only public scholarship information pages. Do not open account, login, eligibility questionnaire, or application workflows.

queue.selectionRationale: The existing portal row represents a potentially large STEM marketplace where provider awards, search results, and scholarships must not be conflated.
queue.plannedBoundary: Read only the FIRST public information page and public provider information pages when statically linked. Do not use search forms, account flows, or applications.

limitations: Queue selection does not establish that a source or child award is current, eligible, active, complete, or unique.
Historical P1-P5 portal counts and observations are prioritization inputs only and are not represented as current live facts.
